title: Asynchronous Programming
description: Event loop, Promise, async/await, parallel bajarish (Promise.all, race, allSettled) va tiplangan API so'rovlari.

blocks.text: JavaScript (va TypeScript) **bir oqimli** (single-threaded) muhitda ishlaydi — bir vaqtda faqat bitta kod qatori bajariladi. Agar tarmoq so'rovi 3 soniya davom etsa-yu, dastur shuncha vaqt "qotib" tursa, foydalanuvchi interfeysi ham qotib qoladi.

Buning oldini olish uchun uzoq davom etadigan amallar (tarmoq, fayl, taymer) **asinxron** bajariladi: amal boshlanadi, dastur esa kutmasdan keyingi kodga o'tadi. Amal tugaganda natija **navbatga** qo'yiladi va bo'sh vaqtda qayta ishlanadi.
Event loop qanday ishlaydi

items: Barcha sinxron kod (**call stack**) oxirigacha bajariladi.
Keyin **macrotask** navbatidan (setTimeout, I/O) bitta vazifa olinadi.

blocks.text: Shuning uchun `setTimeout(fn, 0)` ham darhol emas, balki joriy sinxron kod va barcha Promise'lardan **keyin** bajariladi.
Callback'lardan Promise'gacha

Avval asinxron natija callback orqali olinardi. Ketma-ket bir nechta amal kerak bo'lsa, callback ichida callback... "callback do'zaxi" (callback hell) paydo bo'lardi. **Promise** va **async/await** bu muammoni hal qildi.

blocks.text: **Promise** (va'da) — hali tayyor bo'lmagan, lekin kelajakda paydo bo'ladigan natijani ifodalovchi obyekt. TypeScript'da uning tipi `Promise<T>` — bu yerda `T` muvaffaqiyatli natija tipi.
Promise holatlari
Promise bir marta `fulfilled` yoki `rejected` bo'lgach, holati boshqa **hech qachon o'zgarmaydi**.
Promise yaratish
Natijani olish

items: `.then(value => ...)` — muvaffaqiyatli natijani qayta ishlaydi va **yangi Promise** qaytaradi — shuning uchun zanjir qilish mumkin.
`.finally(() => ...)` — natijadan qat'i nazar bajariladi (masalan, yuklanish belgisini yashirish).

blocks.text: Tayyor qiymatdan darhol Promise yasash: `Promise.resolve(value)` va `Promise.reject(error)`.

examples.title: Xatoni zanjirning istalgan joyida ushlash
examples.code:
function step(name: string, shouldFail = false): Promise<string> {
    return shouldFail
        ? Promise.reject(new Error(`${name} muvaffaqiyatsiz`))
        : Promise.resolve(`${name} bajarildi`)
}

step("1-qadam")
    .then(r => { console.log(r); return step("2-qadam", true) })
    .then(r => { console.log(r); return step("3-qadam") })     // bajarilmaydi
    .catch(e => console.log("Ushlandi:", (e as Error).message))
    .then(() => console.log("catch'dan keyin zanjir davom etadi"))

blocks.text: `async/await` — Promise'lar bilan ishlashning zamonaviy va eng o'qishli usuli. U aslida Promise ustiga qurilgan "sintaktik shakar", lekin kod oddiy, yuqoridan pastga o'qiladigan ko'rinishga ega bo'ladi.
Qoidalar

items: `async` bilan belgilangan funksiya **har doim Promise qaytaradi**. `return 5` yozsangiz ham, natija `Promise<number>` bo'ladi.
`await` Promise natijasini **kutadi** va qiymatni "ochib" beradi: `const user = await getUser()` — `user` ning tipi `User`, `Promise<User>` emas.
`await` faqat `async` funksiya ichida (yoki ES modullarning yuqori darajasida — top-level await) ishlaydi.
`await` funksiyani to'xtatib turadi, lekin **butun dasturni emas** — event loop boshqa ishlarni davom ettiradi.

blocks.text: Xatolarni ushlash
`await` qilingan Promise `rejected` bo'lsa, u oddiy xato kabi **otiladi** (throw). Shuning uchun xatolar tanish `try/catch/finally` bilan ushlanadi.
Qaytish tipini yozish
Async funksiyaning qaytish tipi har doim `Promise<T>` ko'rinishida yoziladi: `async function load(): Promise<User[]>`.
Keng tarqalgan xato — `await` ni unutish. Unda o'zgaruvchida qiymat emas, Promise bo'ladi: `const user = getUser(); user.name` — xato. Yaxshiyamki, TypeScript buni darhol ko'rsatadi.

topics.title: Promise.all, race, allSettled, any
topics.summary: Bir nechta asinxron amalni birga boshqarish

blocks.text: Bir-biriga bog'liq bo'lmagan amallarni **ketma-ket** `await` qilish vaqtni behuda sarflaydi: 3 ta 1 soniyalik so'rov = 3 soniya. Ularni **parallel** ishga tushirsak — jami ~1 soniya.

rows: Hammasi muvaffaqiyatli bo'lganda (bittasi xato bo'lsa — darhol xato)

blocks.text: Tiplar
TypeScript `Promise.all` natijasini **tuple** sifatida aniq tiplaydi: `await Promise.all([getUser(), getOrders()])` natijasi `[User, Order[]]` bo'ladi — har bir o'rin o'z tipida.
`Promise.race` ko'pincha **timeout** qo'yish uchun ishlatiladi: so'rov va ma'lum vaqtdan keyin xato beradigan Promise o'rtasida "poyga".

examples.code:
const respond = (ms: number, server: string) =>
    new Promise<string>(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(`${server} javob berdi (${ms}ms)`), ms))

async function main() {
    const fastest = await Promise.race([
        respond(30, "Server-1"),
        respond(10, "Server-2"),
        respond(20, "Server-3"),
    ])
    console.log("Eng tez:", fastest)
}
main()

topics.title: Typed API Requests (fetch)
topics.summary: Serverdan kelgan ma'lumotni xavfsiz qayta ishlash

blocks.text: `fetch()` — brauzer va Node.js (18+) da HTTP so'rov yuborishning standart usuli. U `Promise<Response>` qaytaradi. JSON javobni olish uchun `await response.json()` chaqiriladi.
`response.json()` ning tipi `Promise<any>`! TypeScript server nima qaytarishini bilmaydi. Natijani to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatsangiz, tip xavfsizligi yo'qoladi.
To'g'ri yondashuv

items: Javob uchun interfeys yozing: `interface Todo { id: number; title: string }`.
`response.ok` ni tekshiring — `fetch` 404 yoki 500 da **xato otmaydi**, faqat tarmoq uzilganda otadi.
Natijaga tip bering. Ishonchli bo'lmagan manbalar uchun runtime tekshiruv (type guard yoki `zod` kabi kutubxona) qiling.
Qayta ishlatiladigan generic yordamchi funksiya yozing: `getJson<T>(url): Promise<T>`.

blocks.text: Quyidagi misollarda ommaviy test API — `jsonplaceholder.typicode.com` ishlatilgan. Kod Node.js 18+ yoki brauzerda ishlaydi.

examples.code:
import { createServer } from "node:http"
import { once } from "node:events"
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net"
const server = createServer((_req, res) => { res.setHeader("content-type", "application/json"); res.end(JSON.stringify({ id: 1, name: "Ali" })) }).listen(0, "127.0.0.1")
await once(server, "listening")
const { port } = server.address() as AddressInfo
type User = { id: number; name: string }
const user = (await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/user`)).json()) as User
console.log(user.name, user.id)
server.close()

examples.title: Status kod bo'yicha xato
POST so'rovi JSON bilan
examples.code:
import { createServer } from "node:http"
import { once } from "node:events"
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net"
const s = createServer(async (req, res) => {
    let body = ""
    for await (const chunk of req) body += chunk
    const data = JSON.parse(body) as { title: string }
    res.setHeader("content-type", "application/json")
    res.statusCode = 201
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ id: 99, ...data }))
}).listen(0, "127.0.0.1")
await once(s, "listening")
const r = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${(s.address() as AddressInfo).port}/posts`, {
    method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: "Yangi post" }),
})
console.log(r.status, await r.json())
s.close()

examples.title: Server so'rov sarlavhalarini qabul qiladi
examples.code:
import { createServer } from "node:http"
import { once } from "node:events"
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net"
const as = createServer((req, res) => { res.statusCode = req.headers.authorization === "Bearer s3cret" ? 200 : 401; res.end(String(res.statusCode)) }).listen(0, "127.0.0.1")
await once(as, "listening")
const u = `http://127.0.0.1:${(as.address() as AddressInfo).port}`
const noAuth = await fetch(u)
const withAuth = await fetch(u, { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer s3cret" } })
console.log(noAuth.status, withAuth.status)
await noAuth.text(); await withAuth.text()
as.close()
